title: Initialization of the Folded Configuration
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a finite type with decidable equality, let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over $\Gamma$, and let $x$ be a word over $\Gamma$. One step of the folding simulator, started on the symbol-wise embedded input, yields the folded configuration of $M$'s initial configuration on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite Turing machine over Γ
x is a list over Γ
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape machine over a finite alphabet $\Gamma$ with decidable
equality and let $x$ be an input over $\Gamma$.  One step of the folding simulator
from its initial configuration on the symbol-wise embedded input $x$ yields exactly
the folded configuration of the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$.
